_meta.units: H = walker height (hood top to boot sole). Street space (s, d, h); +d = LEFT of travel (AGENTS.md).
_meta.confidence_scale: high = measured directly, f-independent, stable over the clip; medium = measured but noisy or depends on one assumption; low = estimate/visual or depends on the focal length guess
_meta.along_street_note: All along-street lengths (house widths, spacings, block lengths) are quoted at walk speed 0.9 H/s, which follows from f = 700 px. They scale together: multiply by (chosen speed / 0.9) to stay consistent with the clip's timing.

horizon_row.how: ground-flow fit dy = k*(y - y_h)^2 over 49k patches (ground_flow.py, fit_flow.py); 349-360 across 5 s windows

height.how: (y_feet - y_h)/(y_feet - y_hood_top) with feet 663, hood top 318 (walker_track.py)

pitch.how: horizon 355 vs image centre 352 (<0.3 deg); building verticals vertical

focal_px.how: shape priors: pot-rim ellipse (~720), door/window aspect in the unrolled facades, old breakdown 680-700; barrel tops too noisy. Not determinable from motion (V/f only).

v_over_f.unit: 1/s (walk speed in H/s divided by f in px)
v_over_f.how: ground flow: V/(f*hc) = 1.44e-3 /s, constant over the clip (+/-1%)

distance_to_walker.unit: H (camera to walker feet, along travel)

lateral_offset_from_carriageway_centre.how: cross_section.py: carriageway edges at -1.31/+1.00 relative to the focus of expansion; camera path 0.15 H right of centre

travel_direction_column.how: focus of expansion from ground flow, 2 s windows 558-657

shake.how: far-street patches move <0.6 px rms at gait frequencies (camera_shake.py): smooth dolly, no bob

slow_yaw_drift.unit: px horizontal over the clip (~ -4.6..+2 deg)
slow_yaw_drift.how: integrated far-patch shift; the street winds gently

gait_cycle.how: ACF of left-right boot difference and hood x: 17.4 frames

bob_amplitude.how: hood top y, +/-8 px at 344 px/H, at step frequency; camera does not bob

sway_amplitude.how: hood centre x +/-9 px at gait-cycle frequency

lateral_wander.how: slow drift of hood centre, 648-682 px

offset_from_camera_path.how: hood centre x 667 vs travel column 620 at feet row

flap_tip_height.how: flap tips 0.60 H below hood top (flap_track.py)

flap_tip_motion.how: tip y/x residuals; weak periodicity, slightly lagging the bob by ~3 frames, anti-phase

carriageway_width.how: grass-mask edges on rows 560-680, every 4th frame (cross_section.py); identical on all rows

curb_top_width.how: grey band 1.41-1.64 raw; raised so slightly overestimated

curb_height.how: visible face height hc*dy/(y - y_h) at row 640

sidewalk_width.how: cobbles beyond the curb to the verge grass

verge_width.how: grass between sidewalk and wall, varies per house

facade_offset.how: wall-base rows in t07/t10 converted with the ground model

cobble_size.how: near cobbles 90-110 px wide x 30-35 px tall at v=285 (across f-independent, along at f=700)

house_width.how: house boundaries in unrolled strips: left 3.7, 4.1, 5.2, 3.7; right ~7 frontages in 18 H (mean 2.6)

ground_floor_height.how: floor beam height in unrolled strips (vertical scale u/|d|, f-independent)

barrel.how: t00 barrel: 142 px tall, 164 px wide at v=228 (f-independent)

string_spacing.how: 7 strings leave the top of frame at t = 2.0, 5.1, 7.7, 12.7, 14.4, 16.2, 18.8 s (string_tracks.py)

string_height_centre.how: 1/(y_h - y) linear in t fit for each string at column 640 (f-independent)

flag_size.how: 40x42 px flags on a string at h-hc = 2.37, w=310 px (size = px*(h-hc)/w)

lantern_sway.how: residuals after the static fit are 1-3 px and common to all lanterns (camera yaw/pitch), i.e. no visible sway

sun_direction.value: ahead-right of travel, low (~25-35 deg elevation)
sun_direction.how: left facades lit, right in shade, shadows on the left wall fall toward the camera, bright far street

sky_low_haze.how: far street glow at the vanishing point

loop_period_frames.how: mean abs diff frame0 vs frame479 = 5.5 (neighbours ~9); the last ~0.3 s morphs back to frame 0
